brandon_marc_beck: In Dunmarrow, Ivo "Rabbit" Beck was a lamplighter. In R-F5, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a lamplighter again.
Ivo "Rabbit" Beck carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.

Ivo "Rabbit" Beck found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo "Rabbit" Beck. Ivo "Rabbit" Beck read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet clipped Ivo "Rabbit" Beck's helmet at R-F5 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low.
gaita_4119: Rafael "Bones" Gaita took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Stand-to at dawn. Rafael "Bones" Gaita put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Nils Photo, badly wounded. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Rafael "Bones" Gaita looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A shell burst in the trench at S-F8. Rafael "Bones" Gaita was thrown against the wall and did not get up. The bearers came at a run.

Rafael "Bones" Gaita lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. A letter from home reached Rafael "Bones" Gaita before dusk. Rafael "Bones" Gaita read it twice and slept a little easier.

The medics would not give up on Rafael "Bones" Gaita. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F8 today. A letter from home reached Rafael "Bones" Gaita before dusk. Rafael "Bones" Gaita read it twice and slept a little easier.
hawkenram: The new machine gunner gave his name as Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
The Concord secured Verdel Ridge. Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
A bullet went through Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram's sleeve at R-F16 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Viktor Newnario of the Hegemony (@newnario).
Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
totally.am.toastyy: On the way to S-F9, Arno Toastyy tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Arno Toastyy is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Arno Toastyy read a theatre review while peeling supper.

Arno Toastyy and Cyril "Mole" Skies carried a kettle through three narrow traverses without spilling a drop. Applause at the destination caused the accident. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Arno Toastyy watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

A clear shot from S-F9. Arno Toastyy badly wounded Wendel Yurboixav and slid back down below the parapet. A bullet went through Arno Toastyy's sleeve at S-F9 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Zeno "Shadow" Maximus of the Concord (@sleetius_maximus).
There were too few medics and too many wounded. Arno Toastyy waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it.
The medics would not give up on Arno Toastyy. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F9 today.
underthrone99: Quentin Underthrone reached S-F2 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Quentin Underthrone (Concord) and Felix "Parson" Brendanm (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near Hill 304. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was. A letter from home reached Quentin Underthrone before dusk. Quentin Underthrone read it twice and slept a little easier.

Quentin Underthrone got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces. A letter from home reached Quentin Underthrone before dusk. Quentin Underthrone read it twice and slept a little easier.
